_comment: Example sqli config file. Pass with -c / --config (e.g. `php sqli.php -c devel.json`) or via $SQLI_CONFIG. Keys match the long option names; every option except config/user-config/help/version is allowed. A --user-config file (or $SQLI_USER_CONFIG) layers on top of this and overrides it; explicit command-line flags override both. Unknown keys (like this _comment) are ignored.
